rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still below VWAP (33.75) and the 9-EMA (33.55), the bounce to ~33.67 was rejected just under VWAP on steadily declining volume (32.7K→11.6K per minute), and the 33.15 target still offers roughly 1.4:1 reward versus the 33.80 invalidation.
